text:
Morgan (People Ops): Quick cribsheet for managers — mid-cycle OKR check-ins + a one-paragraph self-review ICs can paste. Use in 1:1s or async updates. Share feedback here pls :spiral_note_pad:
Priya (Eng Manager): thank you!! can you do a 2-min version I can put in a calendar invite?
Morgan (People Ops): sure — paste this short agenda into a 30m 1:1:
- 5m: status highlight (what moved the needle)
- 10m: biggest blocker or risk
- 10m: support/decisions I need from you
- 5m: quick career/development pulse
Priya (Eng Manager): perfect
Tom (Backend): can we also get a one-paragraph self-review boilerplate for ICs? keeps reviews consistent
Morgan (People Ops): pasted below — IC self-review micro-template (copy/paste):
```
Role & scope: [one line]
Top outcomes this cycle: 1-3 bullets with concise evidence (links or metrics)
What I learned / tradeoffs I made: 1-2 lines
Current blockers: short, ask for manager
One growth ask (next cycle): 1 sentence
```
Morgan (People Ops): and a filled example (very short):
```
Role & scope: Backend engineer focused on inference runtime
Top outcomes: 1) Reduced 99p tail by 35% via batching (PR #314), 2) Added cache evictions that cut cost by 12% (dashboard link)
Learned: latency-cost tradeoff when increasing batch depth
Blockers: need infra quota bump for dedicated tests
Growth ask: lead a cross-team perf review
```
Carlos (ML Eng): love the example. can we add a two-question upward feedback template managers can send to teams?
Morgan (People Ops): yes — upward feedback (2 q's, async-friendly):
1) What should I stop/start/continue doing as your manager? (1-2 bullets)
2) What can I unblock for you in the next two weeks? (one short ask)
Priya (Eng Manager): For calibration meetings, any recommended artifact to bring? e.g., short evidence list
Morgan (People Ops): bring the IC microself-review + 2-3 supporting links (PRs, dashboards, customer notes). Use this rubric snippet in calibration: Impact / Ownership / Growth potential — 1-line rating per dimension.
Tom (Backend): pinging @OKRs Bot — is there an automated reminder we can schedule for mid-cycle check-ins?
OKRs Bot: You can schedule a "mid-cycle check-in" reminder at 2 weeks before cycle midpoint. Use `/okr remind add --when "2w-before-midpoint" --scope team`. See /docs/okr/reminders
Priya (Eng Manager): will try that, thanks :thumbsup:
Morgan (People Ops): quick ask — if you adapt templates, drop the version here so we can iterate (helps standardization).
Priya (Eng Manager): noted, will add our tweak for on-call rotations
Carlos (ML Eng): :eyes:
Morgan (People Ops): thanks team — tagging FYI for POCs who asked: @Priya, @Tom
